resource-summary.title: 리소스별 요청 수·지연·오류율 (/api/v1/{target})
resource-summary.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\//
| parse endpoint /^\/api\/v1\/(?<target>[^\/]+)/
| fields concat("/api/v1/", target) as apiGroup, if(status >= 400 and status < 500, 1, 0) as is4xx, if(status >= 500, 1, 0) as is5xx
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(elapsedMs, 50) as p50Ms, pct(elapsedMs, 95) as p95Ms, pct(elapsedMs, 99) as p99Ms, sum(is4xx) as responses4xx, sum(is5xx) as responses5xx, 100 * sum(is5xx) / count(*) as error5xxPct by apiGroup
| sort requests desc
| limit 100

endpoint-summary.title: 세부 API별 요청 수·지연·오류율 (method + 경로 패턴)
endpoint-summary.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\//
| fields if(status >= 400 and status < 500, 1, 0) as is4xx, if(status >= 500, 1, 0) as is5xx
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(elapsedMs, 50) as p50Ms, pct(elapsedMs, 95) as p95Ms, pct(elapsedMs, 99) as p99Ms, max(elapsedMs) as maxMs, sum(is4xx) as responses4xx, sum(is5xx) as responses5xx, 100 * sum(is5xx) / count(*) as error5xxPct by method, endpoint
| sort requests desc
| limit 100

read-reservation-mix.title: 조회·예매·기타 요청 비율 (공개 예매 POST만 예매)
read-reservation-mix.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\//
| fields if(method = "GET", 1, 0) as isRead, if(method = "POST" and endpoint = "/api/v1/public/shows/{showId}/sessions/{sessionId}/reservations", 1, 0) as isReservation
| stats count(*) as totalRequests, sum(isRead) as reads, sum(isReservation) as reservations
| fields totalRequests, reads, reservations, totalRequests - reads - reservations as otherRequests, 100 * reads / totalRequests as readPct, 100 * reservations / totalRequests as reservationPct

resource-requests-minute.title: 리소스별 요청 수 (1분 합계)
resource-requests-minute.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\//
| parse endpoint /^\/api\/v1\/(?<target>[^\/]+)/
| stats count(*) as requests by bin(1m), target

public-latency-minute.title: 공개 API별 p95 응답 시간 (ms, 1분)
public-latency-minute.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\/public\//
| fields concat(method, " ", endpoint) as api
| stats pct(elapsedMs, 95) as p95Ms by bin(1m), api

reservation-outcomes.title: 예매 결과별 요청 수·p95 (매진·중복과 서버 오류 구분)
reservation-outcomes.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and method = "POST" and endpoint = "/api/v1/public/shows/{showId}/sessions/{sessionId}/reservations"
| fields coalesce(errorCode, "NONE") as resultCode
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(elapsedMs, 95) as p95Ms, max(elapsedMs) as maxMs by status, resultCode
| sort requests desc

api-error-codes.title: API별 4xx·5xx와 오류 코드
api-error-codes.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\// and status >= 400
| fields coalesce(errorCode, "NONE") as resultCode
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(elapsedMs, 95) as p95Ms by method, endpoint, status, resultCode
| sort requests desc
| limit 100

slow-api-requests.title: 느린 API 요청 상위 30개 (처리 시간 순)
slow-api-requests.query:
filter event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and endpoint like /^\/api\/v1\//
| fields @timestamp, method, endpoint, status, elapsedMs, errorCode, requestId
| sort elapsedMs desc
| limit 30

error-details.title: 오류 상세 · 예외와 stack trace
error-details.query:
filter event in ["UNEXPECTED_ERROR", "UNEXPECTED_SERVICE_ERROR", "RUNTIME_METRICS_FAILURE"] or (event = "HTTP_REQUEST" and status >= 500)
| fields @timestamp, event, method, endpoint, status, errorCode, requestId, exception, message, stack_trace
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

request-trace.title: requestId 추적 (저장 쿼리에서 ID 교체)
request-trace.query:
filter requestId = "REPLACE_WITH_REQUEST_ID"
| fields @timestamp, event, method, endpoint, status, elapsedMs, errorCode, exception, message, stack_trace, @message
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 200

slow-services.title: 느린 서비스 호출 · 500ms 이상
slow-services.query:
filter event = "SLOW_SERVICE"
| fields @timestamp, class, method, outcome, elapsedMs, requestId
| sort elapsedMs desc
| limit 30

runtime-memory.title: JVM·호스트 메모리 (MiB)
runtime-memory.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| fields JvmHeapUsed / 1048576 as heapMiB, JvmHeapMax / 1048576 as heapMaxMiB, JvmNonHeapUsed / 1048576 as nonHeapMiB, HostMemoryAvailable / 1048576 as availableMiB, HostSwapUsed / 1048576 as swapMiB
| stats avg(heapMiB) as heapUsed, max(heapMaxMiB) as heapMax, avg(nonHeapMiB) as nonHeap, min(availableMiB) as hostAvailable, max(swapMiB) as hostSwap by bin(1m)

runtime-threads.title: Tomcat busy·max / JVM live threads
runtime-threads.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats max(TomcatThreadsBusy) as busy, max(TomcatThreadsMax) as configuredMax, max(JvmThreadsLive) as jvmLive by bin(1m)

runtime-db-pool.title: Hikari active·idle·pending·max
runtime-db-pool.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats max(DbConnectionsActive) as active, min(DbConnectionsIdle) as idle, max(DbConnectionsPending) as pending, max(DbConnectionsMax) as configuredMax by bin(1m)

runtime-db-acquire.title: Hikari 연결 획득 대기 (ms)
runtime-db-acquire.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats avg(DbConnectionAcquireMeanMs) as intervalMeanMs, max(DbConnectionAcquireMaxMs) as rollingMaxMs by bin(1m)

runtime-gc-pause.title: GC pause 합계 / 최근 최대 (ms)
runtime-gc-pause.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats sum(GcPauseTimeMs) as intervalPauseMs, max(GcPauseMaxMs) as rollingMaxMs by bin(1m)

runtime-gc-ratio.title: GC pause / 실제 수집 간격 (%)
runtime-gc-ratio.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats avg(GcPauseRatio) as pausePct by bin(1m)

runtime-cpu.title: 프로세스 CPU 사용률 (%)
runtime-cpu.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats max(ProcessCpuUsage) as cpuPct by bin(1m)

runtime-events.title: GC 횟수 / Hikari timeout 횟수 (표본 간 증가분)
runtime-events.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| stats sum(GcPauseCount) as gcPauses, sum(DbConnectionTimeouts) as connectionTimeouts by bin(1m)

runtime-latest.title: 런타임 최신 원문 (전체 지표 펼쳐 보기)
runtime-latest.query:
filter event = "RUNTIME_METRICS"
| fields @timestamp, @message
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 5

database-cache-memory.title: InnoDB 캐시 데이터 / 용량 (MiB)
database-cache-memory.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| fields BufferPoolUsedBytes / 1048576 as usedMiB, BufferPoolCapacityBytes / 1048576 as capacityMiB
| stats avg(usedMiB) as cachedData, max(capacityMiB) as capacity by bin(1m)

database-cache-ratio.title: InnoDB 캐시 적중률 / dirty page (%)
database-cache-ratio.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats avg(BufferPoolCacheHitPct) as cacheHitPct, max(BufferPoolDirtyPct) as dirtyPct by bin(1m)

database-connections.title: MySQL 연결·최대 연결·실행 중 thread
database-connections.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats max(MysqlConnections) as connections, max(MysqlMaxConnections) as configuredMax, max(MysqlThreadsRunning) as running by bin(1m)

database-query-rate.title: MySQL queries / second
database-query-rate.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats avg(QueriesPerSecond) as queriesPerSecond by bin(1m)

database-lock-waits.title: InnoDB 현재 행 잠금 대기 / 신규 대기 횟수
database-lock-waits.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats max(RowLockCurrentWaits) as currentWaits, sum(RowLockWaits) as intervalWaits by bin(1m)

database-lock-time.title: InnoDB 행 잠금 대기 시간 (ms / 표본 간 합계)
database-lock-time.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats sum(RowLockTimeMs) as lockTimeMs by bin(1m)

database-host-memory.title: DB 호스트 가용 메모리 / swap 사용 (MiB)
database-host-memory.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| fields HostMemoryAvailable / 1048576 as availableMiB, HostSwapUsed / 1048576 as swapMiB
| stats min(availableMiB) as available, max(swapMiB) as swapUsed by bin(1m)

database-swap-io.title: DB 호스트 swap in/out (bytes / 표본 간 합계)
database-swap-io.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats sum(HostSwapInBytes) as swapIn, sum(HostSwapOutBytes) as swapOut by bin(1m)

database-disk-io.title: DB 데이터 디스크 read/write (bytes / 표본 간 합계)
database-disk-io.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats sum(DataDiskReadBytes) as readBytes, sum(DataDiskWriteBytes) as writeBytes by bin(1m)

database-disk-time.title: DB 데이터 디스크 I/O 활성 시간 (ms / 표본 간 합계)
database-disk-time.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats sum(DataDiskIoTimeMs) as ioActiveMs by bin(1m)

database-slow-queries.title: MySQL slow query 횟수 (표본 간 증가분)
database-slow-queries.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| stats sum(SlowQueries) as slowQueries by bin(1m)

database-latest.title: DB 최신 원문 (전체 지표 펼쳐 보기)
database-latest.query:
filter event = "DATABASE_METRICS"
| fields @timestamp, @message
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 5
